label: alleged
text: Cockroach Janta Party said on X that there could be election rigging in India, not vote theft.

sources.outlet: Cockroach Janta Party ("Cockroach Is Back" account on X)
sources.verified: the party's replacement X account after its original was withheld in India, announced by founder Abhijeet Dipke and reported by The Free Press Journal and ThePrint
sources.articleText: भारत में “Election Rigging” हो सकती है, “वोट चोरी” नहीं !
